items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: him and I are good buddies. I go by and chew the rag with him, sit there and talk about old times.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, he -- have you seen him lately?

We belong to the same club. See, they got a club called the Friendly Fifty, where I -- where they decided, every time you don't see one of the old fellows, only at funeral all you have, somebodys (unintelligible). So we decided we going to make a club, no politics or anything, just for us to get together and see each other. Once each and every month they have regular meetings, and they have the outing in August. Then we have the regular November cocktail dinner and dance. Doc (unintelligible) comes there. Lot of…
Well, is Walter still working down on Wall Street?
